54 models in 90 days. The AI landscape just became unrecognizable.

One new AI model every four days. That is the pace right now. ByteDance, Nvidia, Microsoft, Mistral — all shipping within the same two-week window. And the pricing war just escalated: Grok 4.5 reset the floor at $2 and $6 per million tokens, with competitors matching almost immediately.

Here is what this means if you are running a business: the performance difference between the top models has compressed so tightly that picking 'the best one' is no longer a meaningful strategy. What matters now is architecture — how you route different tasks to different models, how fast you can swap providers when a better option appears, and how you capture the cost deflation as margin instead of waste.

Mistral's latest model runs 119 billion parameters but activates only 6 billion per query. That is the direction everything is moving — more capability, radically less cost.

The executive skill is no longer choosing a model. It is designing the system that makes every model interchangeable.
